notes:
**Cards work from every screen.** Job cards and run cards tapped on the machine's reader now open (or open
and start) the job whichever screen Studio is on, straight from a cold start - the Print page no longer
has to have been visited first. Scanning a supply cartridge to add it to an order works the same way.

**Kiosk Mode hands over to the Print page.** Tap a job card while the kiosk screen is up and Studio leaves
the kiosk and lands on the Print page with the job loaded, ready to run. Elsewhere a job card still opens
the job on the screen you are working in.

**Reader feedback.** When a tag is held too briefly or off the reader, Studio says so ("The tag didn't
read - hold it flat on the reader and try again") instead of doing nothing. The Tags & QR Codes tool now
warns in amber when a code is too long for a standard NTAG213 card and suggests an NTAG215 or larger,
before you try to write it.

**Dealer branding fixes.** A dealer list saved by an older version could leave the dealer code blank, so
the toolbar logo and dealer page details never arrived from the portal; that is repaired automatically.

**Placement popup.** Dragging a print band no longer jitters or changes the band's size when a coverage
or seam warning appears under the head rows.
